business_problem: Radius had only 60 days to launch RED Fiber and needed to replace paper forms, manual encoding, and fragmented order-to-installation steps so it could support a new B2C subscriber base without slowing revenue realization.
solution_summary: Radius built an all-digital customer-to-billing flow for RED Fiber on the ServiceNow AI Platform. Direct sales moved from paper forms and spreadsheets into Telecommunications Service Management, where reps can capture subscriber information on smart devices instead of waiting for office staff to re-encode applications. Workflow Data Fabric connects that service layer to other systems so credit checks, customer records, and downstream actions stay synchronized. For self-service, the RED Fiber Customer Portal collects subscriber information and supporting documents, then Field Service Management dispatches installation work orders to field technicians through a mobile workflow. Jumio and Zuora integrations support identity verification and billing, while agents see order status at every stage and technicians can provision service with barcode scanning. The result is one order-lifecycle system that compresses lead-to-cash time and gives Radius a repeatable launch model for future growth.

data_flow: Subscriber applications enter through direct sales devices or the RED Fiber Customer Portal and land in Telecommunications Service Management. Workflow Data Fabric synchronizes those requests with identity-verification and billing systems, after which Field Service Management dispatches work orders so technicians can provision service and update order status from the field.
business_outcome: Radius reduced new-installation delivery time by 80%, saved 72 work hours per day in field-service dispatch, went live in 60 days, reassigned 14 full-time encoders after automation, enabled next-day provisioning instead of five days, and reported 20% year-over-year revenue growth from the improved process.

evidence_quotes: With just 60 days to launch the new RED Fiber service to its new customer base, Radius needed a new solution to manage the entire order lifecycle-from sales leads to the provisioning of services.

Using ServiceNow Workflow Data Fabric to connect with other systems, direct sales agents can capture customer information with a smart device connected to the ServiceNow AI Platform instead of waiting for paper forms to be returned to the office.
Radius has automated the end-to-end process from customer order to installation with ServiceNow Telecommunications Service Management and ServiceNow Field Service Management.

Radius also uses ServiceNow Workflow Data Fabric to integrate ServiceNow Telecommunications Service Management and ServiceNow Field Service Management with applications, including Jumio for identity verification and Zuora for billing.
By uniting telecom service and field operations on one platform, we can provision services to new subscribers the next day instead of in five days.
